title.en: Capacitance and the parallel plate capacitor

body.en: A capacitor is two conductors separated by an insulator, carrying charges +Q and −Q. Its capacitance C = Q/V depends only on size, shape, separation and the medium, not on Q or V. Unit: farad (1 F = 1 C V⁻¹); practical units are μF, nF and pF. For two *parallel plates* of area A, separation d, in vacuum: $C = \varepsilon_0A/d$.
body.kn: ಧಾರಕ ಎಂದರೆ ನಿರೋಧಕದಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಟ್ಟ +Q ಮತ್ತು −Q ಆವೇಶದ ಎರಡು ವಾಹಕಗಳು. ಧಾರಕತೆ C = Q/V, ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್. ಸಮಾಂತರ ಫಲಕ ಧಾರಕ: C = ε₀A/d.

title.en: On the board: the parallel plate capacitor

narration.en: A parallel plate capacitor: two plates of area A, a distance d apart, carrying +Q and −Q. Between the plates the field is uniform, E = σ/ε₀, so V = Ed = Qd/(ε₀A). So the capacitance C = Q/V = ε₀A/d depends only on the size, shape and gap. Example: A = 6 × 10⁻³ m² and d = 3 mm give C = 17.7 picofarad. A dielectric filling the gap multiplies C by K; a slab of thickness t gives ε₀A over d − t + t/K.

say.en: A parallel plate capacitor: two plates of area A, a distance d apart, carrying +Q and −Q.
Between the plates the field is uniform, E = σ/ε₀, so V = Ed = Qd/(ε₀A).
So the capacitance C = Q/V = ε₀A/d depends only on the size, shape and gap.
Example: A = 6 × 10⁻³ m² and d = 3 mm give C = 17.7 picofarad.
A dielectric filling the gap multiplies C by K; a slab of thickness t gives ε₀A over d − t + t/K.

A parallel plate capacitor: two plates of area A, a distance d apart, carrying plus Q and -Q. Between the plates the field is uniform, E equals sigma divided by epsilon 0, so V equals Ed equals Qd over epsilon 0A. So the capacitance C equals Q over V equals epsilon 0A/d depends only on the size, shape and gap. Example: A equals 6 times 10 to the power minus 3 square metres and d equals 3 millimetres give C equals 17.7 picofarad. A dielectric filling the gap multiplies C by K; a slab of thickness t gives epsilon 0A over d - t plus t over K.

body.en: Filling the whole gap with a *dielectric* of constant K multiplies the capacitance by K: $C = K\varepsilon_0A/d$. A slab of thickness t (< d) gives $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t + t/K)$. A metal slab of thickness t behaves like K → ∞: $C = \varepsilon_0A/(d - t)$.
body.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

narration.en: Filling the gap with a dielectric multiplies C by K. A slab of thickness t gives epsilon nought A over d minus t plus t by K. A metal slab simply reduces the gap to d minus t.
narration.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t + t/K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C = ε₀A/(d − t).

say.en: Filling the gap with a dielectric multiplies C by K. A slab of thickness t gives epsilon nought A over d minus t plus t by K. A metal slab simply reduces the gap to d minus t. Full dielectric: C equals KC 0.
say.kn: ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಂತರವನ್ನು K ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದರೆ ಧಾರಕತೆ K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ. t ದಪ್ಪದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C equals epsilon 0A/(d - t plus t over K); ಲೋಹದ ಹಾಳೆಗೆ C equals epsilon 0A/(d - t).

say.en: Slab: C equals epsilon 0A/(d - t plus t over K).
Metal slab: C equals epsilon 0A/(d - t).

problem.en: A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 6 × 10⁻³ m² separated by 3 mm of air. Find its capacitance and the charge on each plate when connected to 100 V.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 6 × 10⁻³ m² separated by 3 mm of air. Find its capacitance and the charge on each plate when connected to 100 V.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A parallel plate capacitor has plates of area 6 times 10 to the power minus 3 square metres separated by 3 millimetres of air. Find its capacitance and the charge on each plate when connected to 100 volts.
C equals epsilon 0A/d equals 8.85 times 10 to the power minus 12 times 6 times 10 to the power minus 3 divided by 3 times 10 to the power minus 3.
C equals 1.77 times 10 to the power minus 11 F equals 17.7 picofarads.
Q equals CV equals 1.77 times 10 to the power minus 11 times 100 equals 1.77 times 10 to the power minus 9 C.
So the answer is 17.7 picofarads; 1.77 nC.

problem.en: The gap of the same capacitor is filled with mica (K = 6) while the battery stays connected. Find the new capacitance and charge.

steps.en: The battery holds V at 100 V.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. The gap of the same capacitor is filled with mica (K = 6) while the battery stays connected. Find the new capacitance and charge.

say.en: Let us solve this together. The gap of the same capacitor is filled with mica K equals 6 while the battery stays connected. Find the new capacitance and charge.
C equals KC 0 equals 6 times 17.7 equals 106.2 picofarads.
The battery holds V at 100 volts.
Q equals CV equals 106.2 times 10 to the power minus 12 times 100 equals 1.06 times 10 to the power minus 8 C.
So the answer is 106.2 picofarads; about 1.06 times 10 to the power minus 8 C.

title.en: Combination of capacitors and stored energy

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. C equals Q over V; unit farad.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. C equals Q over V; ಏಕಮಾನ ಫ್ಯಾರಡ್.

say.en: Parallel plates: C equals epsilon 0A/d.
A dielectric multiplies C by K.
say.kn: ಪರಾವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ವಸ್ತು C ಯನ್ನು K ಪಟ್ಟು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Battery connected: V fixed; disconnected: Q fixed.
say.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಟರಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ: V ಸ್ಥಿರ; ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿದಾಗ: Q ಸ್ಥಿರ.

say.en: Next: Combination of capacitors and stored energy.
say.kn: ಮುಂದೆ: ಧಾರಕಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿತ ಶಕ್ತಿ.
